fields.description: Running high score: FUN_0801f498 keeps the maximum of the incoming int score at save offset 0x0C (fresh save is 0).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f498 (result handler): if (*(int*)(iVar2+0x0C) < *param_1) *(int*)(iVar2+0x0C)=*param_1; buffer persisted by FUN_0801f1fc EEPROM-write loop over 0x19 addresses.
fields.name: high_score

fields.description: Best sub-score: FUN_0801f498 keeps the maximum of a result byte (param_1+0x4B) at save offset 0x10; stored via a u32 write so it always fits in a byte.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f498: if (*(int*)(iVar2+0x10) < (byte)param_1[0x4B]) *(uint*)(iVar2+0x10)=(byte)param_1[0x4B]; init leaves +0x10 zero (FUN_0801f2b4 memset 0xC4).
fields.name: best_combo_value

fields.description: Highest stage/mode index reached (byte-range value in a u32). Init sets 0xFFFFFFFF (-1 = no progress); FUN_0801f70c treats a negative value here as fresh/empty.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f2b4 inits save+0x14 to 0xFFFFFFFF; FUN_0801f498 max-updates it from the mode byte pcVar1[4]; FUN_0801f70c checks *(int*)(base+0x14) < 0 for save validity.
fields.name: max_stage

fields.description: Completion/unlock flag: set to 1 when the masked mode bits match (extra clear condition); 0 in a fresh save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f498: if ((*(uint*)(pcVar1+4) & DAT_0801f53c)==DAT_0801f540) *(u32*)(iVar2+0x18)=1; FUN_0801f2b4 inits save+0x18 to 0.
fields.name: completion_unlock_flag

fields.description: First word of the 11-entry by 12-byte ranked record table at save+0x1C (init fills all 11 entries with the same triple). FUN_0801f434 inserts FUN_0801f410-derived values here in ascending (min-best-first) order.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f2b4 builds 11 x 12-byte entries at save+0x1C from ROM triple (DAT_0801f368/36c/370 = 0xEA60/0x1D4C0/0x0202BF20, ascending); FUN_0801f434 ranked-inserts score iVar1 at base+param_2*0xC+0x1C.
fields.name: ranked_record_0

fields.description: Best record (lower is better): FUN_0801f498 stores the minimum nonzero FUN_0801f410 value (course*100+byte) at save offset 0xA0; 0 means unset.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f498: iVar4=FUN_0801f410(short@+0x46,byte@+0x12); if (iVar5==0 || iVar4<iVar5) *(int*)(iVar2+0xA0)=iVar4; FUN_0801f2b4 inits +0xA0 to 0.
fields.name: best_record

fields.description: Last result score word copied from the live result struct into save offset 0xA8 on every recorded play.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f498 result-copy branch: *(int*)(iVar4+0xA8)=param_1[0xE]; iVar4 is the save buffer (offsets +0xA4..+0xBC), persisted by FUN_0801f1fc.
fields.name: last_score_value

fields.description: Slot-active marker: 0xFF in a fresh save, overwritten with a gameplay byte on the first recorded result; FUN_0801f70c treats a negative (signed) value here as empty.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f2b4 inits save+0xB6 to 0xFF; FUN_0801f498 overwrites it from *(DAT_0801f624+4); FUN_0801f70c checks *(char*)(base+0xB6) < 0.
fields.name: save_active_marker

fields.description: Last course/song value (u16): copied from the live result struct; it is also the first input of the FUN_0801f410 score formula used for best_record and the ranked table.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f498 result-copy branch: *(u16*)(iVar4+0xB8)=*(u16*)(param_1+0x46); same source feeds iVar4=FUN_0801f410(short@+0x46,...) for the +0xA0 best update.
fields.name: last_course_value
